scope: fixed-P controlled validation before any learned policy comparison
execution_specification_fields_to_resolv: final source and prerequisite receipts, including the Prompt 14 exact applied-allocation contract
exact operator, runtime, JNI and workload hashes, image digests and loaded identity evidence
worker, physical device, namespace, job IDs, broker/topics and ownership
allowed mutations, exact native transport and failure/cleanup boundary
parallelism, matched source trace, seed, initial state and input progress
anchor and held-out capacities inside validated native support, per-task memory floor and resource ceilings
fixed and online effective configuration and policy treatment allowlist
trial IDs, placement and observation windows, absolute duration and resource caps
predeclared workload SLO, resource feasibility margins, confidence and supported forecast criteria
output directory, cleanup ownership and early-stop limits

matched_start_contract.topology: Use one declared fixed parallelism throughout each controlled-capacity comparison.
matched_start_contract.state: Use the same content-addressed starting state, dataset seed, partition offsets and input progress boundaries.
matched_start_contract.population: Record exact native all-lookup and foreground classes and the matching join input counters.
matched_start_contract.window: Fit on earlier disjoint observations. Predeclare held-out windows and exact phase/progress inclusion from Prompt 17.
matched_start_contract.resource_policy: Retain one metadata policy and a verified per-task write floor. Independently verify observed native capacity and managed allocation.
matched_start_contract.placement: Run sequentially on matching worker and physical storage. Record disk pressure, host I/O/CPU, RocksDB compaction, pending work and write stalls.

cells.purpose: Verify current-allocation telemetry, exact miss anchor error, repeatability and the identical-action control.

arms.B: predeclared supported held-out capacity at the same P

cells.purpose: Freeze predictions before the held-out measurement. Verify complete current-epoch applied receipts and score MRC, actual-miss service and combined errors separately.
Use a predeclared phase/load step and matching record progress. Measure coupled write/compaction effects and retain transition time in whole-policy utility.

read_cache_only_requires: equal observed write-buffer budget and metadata placement at the measured endpoints

qualification_rules.telemetry: Require full identity and count conservation for the same scope, original prior inputs, and evidence of the actual applied allocation.
qualification_rules.mrc: Record signed feasibility-boundary outcomes and absolute percentage-point errors. Fix the decision margin from the serialized policy input in advance. The supported error and uncertainty bound must fit inside that margin for every binding task.
qualification_rules.service_cost: Compare the actual-miss oracle, genuine prior MRC forecast, legacy fixed cost and recent compatible busy/input baseline. Determine the tolerable cost error from the predeclared demand headroom at the binding task. Missing dispersion or a crossed feasibility boundary stops learned qualification.
qualification_rules.support: Keep out-of-support or cross-P results diagnostic. Use trials as repetitions and keep any overlap explicit.
qualification_rules.control: Require linked request, native placement and completed work with resource integrals when measured. Identical final or applied resources remain controls. A higher rate alone supplies no allocation claim.

instrumentation_comparison.separate_plan_if_authorized: Use paired fixed allocation and identical input with instrumentation as the sole treatment. Keep resource and latency comparisons separate from policy selection.

early_stop: identity or population mismatch, incompatible interval or event conservation failure
known unsafe write budget or resource limit
unverified or mismatched active allocation, actuator fallback or rejected request
host/storage interference, incomplete authorization or exhausted declared budget
